item.title: Police probed insider links in Lae’s exploding card cloning scandal
item.description: Lae’s growing bank card cloning scandal took a darker turn, with police confirming that insiders, including members of the force and bank personnel, were under investigation for their alleged involvement in the syndicates. Chief Superintendent Chris Kunyanban said what began as a financial fraud investigation had uncovered a deeper and more troubling possibility: that those entrusted to protect public money and uphold the law may have helped criminals breach the system from within. item.title: East Nakanai LLG launches first 2026 patrol visit to Meramera area
item.description: East Nakanai Local-Level Government (ENLLG) has officially commenced its 2026 field engagement program, deploying a multi-sectoral team to the Meramera area early this week. This mission marks the first patrol of the year for the Nakanai District Constituency.
